claim: 暖かい is glossed plain 'Warm' while every other temperature word in the deck says whether it is about weather or things, so the back drops the weather sense its own kanji card teaches and leaves it indistinguishable from the 温 'Warm (to the touch)' the learner already knows.
evidence: 暖かい back: 'Answer: Warm'. Same unit: 暖 'Answer: Warm (weather)', 涼しい 'Answer: Cool (weather)', 冷たい 'Answer: Cold (things; people)'. Earlier: 温 'Warm (to the touch)', 寒い 'Cold (weather, not used for things)', 暑い 'Hot (weather)', 熱い 'Hot (thing)'.
fix: Gloss it 'Warm (weather)' to match 暖, 涼しい and 暑い.
verdictReason: The card is faithful to the book: Lesson 10's vocabulary glosses it plain ("あたたかい 暖かい warm") while qualifying 涼しい "cool (weather—not used for things)" and 冷たい "cold (things/people)", so the deck mirrors the book's own choice; on a one-face reading deck nothing collides with it (no other word card is glossed "Warm"; 温 is a silent kanji card in chapter-9 and 温かい is carded nowhere), and preflight's different-English check passes. The book's choice looking odd is not a finding.

claim: Five suffix cards carry a leading full-width 〜 in the romaji line that the front does not show, the only cards in the collection to do so (the other marked suffixes use an ASCII ~ or nothing), so the Says line mixes a Japanese placeholder into romaji and disagrees with the written form above it.
evidence: 方面 'Says: 〜hōmen' (r-c64f974fa90b), 番線 'Says: 〜bansen' (r-856d5830b52b), 週間 'Says: 〜shūkan' (r-ae5d2000edcb), 行き 'Says: 〜iki' (r-cd91af5d05a4), か月 'Says: 〜kagetsu' (r-370f0655dc10). Fronts: '方面', '番線', '週間', '行き', 'か月'. Earlier suffix-like card 時間 'Time; ... hours (duration)' has no 〜 in its romaji. Book prints "〜方面", "〜番線", "〜しゅうかん 〜週間", "〜行き", "〜かげつ 〜か月". Cards: r-c64f974fa90b 方面 "〜hōmen", r-856d5830b52b 番線 "〜bansen", r-ae5d2000edcb 週間 "〜shūkan", r-cd91af5d05a4 行き "〜iki", r-370f0655dc10 か月 "〜kagetsu"; the only other marked romaji in the collection use an ASCII tilde (chapter-5 時間 "~jikan", chapter-13 代 "~dai"), and other suffix cards carry none.
fix: Drop the 〜 from these pronunciations (the English already says '. . .'), or settle one convention for the whole collection and add it to the romaji-style lint.
verdictReason: Verified in cards.json: pronunciation is "〜hōmen", "〜bansen", "〜shūkan", "〜iki", "〜kagetsu" on r-c64f974fa90b, r-856d5830b52b, r-ae5d2000edcb, r-cd91af5d05a4, r-370f0655dc10, while every target is tilde-free (reconcileReading strips the placeholder from target and reading; the 〜 was reintroduced by the romaji-correction pass, candidates/romanization.json). Collection-wide scan of every cards.json: the only other marked suffix romaji are chapter-5 時間 "~jikan" and chapter-13 代 "~dai" (ASCII), and the excluded 次は "tsugi wa 〜". Not a preflight duplicate: the placeholder-target check (src/audit/checks/collection.js) reads target, not pronunciation, and preflight is clean on chapter-11. Polish stands; the fix is one convention for the collection.

claim: The vocabulary word 春 (はる, spring) has no word card: the build generated it, then silently dropped it as a repeat of chapter-5's silent KANJIDIC character card 春, so the word's reading はる is never voiced in the deck.
evidence: Book, Lesson 10 Nouns: "はる 春 spring". chapter-11/as-generated.json has {id r-3e450648252d, target 春, english "Spring", ttsText はる}; chapter-11/cards.json has no 春 and reading-report.json lists no drop for it. chapter-5 r-3e450648252d: 春 "Spring (season)", pronunciation "shun / haru", no audio, reviewNote "Not taught by the book yet: meaning and readings from KANJIDIC2".
fix: Turn chapter-5 r-3e450648252d into the word card (reading はる, voiced) as the plugin's 'a kanji the book also teaches as a word is one card, the word' rule says, or move it into this unit as the word.
verdictReason: Book Lesson 10 Nouns: "はる 春 spring". as-generated.json has r-3e450648252d 春 "Spring" ttsText はる; cards.json has no 春 and reading-report.json lists no drop. Collection-wide grep: the only 春 card is chapter-5 r-3e450648252d, a silent KANJIDIC card "Spring (season)" (shun / haru), and the only other card containing 春 is 春分の日 (しゅん), so はる is voiced nowhere. Mechanism verified in code: the 2026-09-28 character step (dropCharactersCardedEarlier, src/reading/characterGaps.js) treats any single-kanji target an earlier unit holds as a repeated character card, so a one-kanji WORD card is removed in place too, and the removal is only returned to the caller, never written to reading-report.json or candidates/characters.json (neither names it). That inverts card-rules-reading.md rule 4 and 05-japanese-plugin.md ("a single kanji the book also teaches as a word on its own is a word card, and has audio"). Same id in both units, so the design's own path is to update chapter-5's card in place (chapter-5 is meta.done, so by hand); precedent shape: chapter-10 r-1391f4a4c627 色 "Color", ttsText いろ, voiced.
